newsitem.title: USA: Oregon unemployment rate declines in Sept - report.
newsitem.headline: Oregon unemployment rate declines in Sept - report.

text.p: Oregon's seasonally adjusted unemployment rate declined four-tenths of a percentage point to 5.0 percent in September, the state's Employment Department said on Tuesday.
With the exception of August 1996, Oregon's seasonally adjusted unemployment rate has been below the national rate for the past three years, the department said.

"The decrease in the unemployment rate should not come as a surprise," said Jeffrey Dreiling, a research analyst with the department. "Oregon's seasonally adjusted employment has increased steadily over the last three months."
Oregon has added 21,200 jobs since June, compared with 25,100 added during the first six months of 1996.
The monthly survey of businesses showed 7,200 seasonally adjusted jobs were added in September. The department said most industries experienced employment gains.
